`Demo` module definition
========================

**Packages**: DemoDashboard, DemoAPIs, DemoCustomDisp, DemoDSFR

This module contains demo **order management** application.

Domains
-------

_Domains organize the application's main navigation menu. Each domain groups the objects, processes, and external pages accessible to users from it. Domains can be nested: a domain may have a parent domain._

* `DemoDomain`
  * `DemoSupplier` _(object)_
  * `DemoProduct` _(object)_
  * `DemoClient` _(object)_
  * `DemoOrder` _(object)_
  * `DemoContact` _(object)_
  * `DemoDashboard` _(external)_
  * `DemoStats1` _(object)_
  * `DemoStats2` _(object)_
  * `DemoOrderCreate` _(workflow)_
  * `DemoPlaceNewOrder` _(external)_
  * `DemoOrderAgenda` _(external)_
  * `DemoCatalog` _(external)_
  * `RedoLog` _(object)_
* `DemoSubDomain` _(sub-domain of `DemoDomain`)_

`DemoContact` (Contact) business object definition
--------------------------------------------------

The **contact** object holds the interactions with the clients.

A contact can be linked or not a an order of the selelcted client
(when linked to an order the `demoCtcOrdId` field is set).

**Physical table**: `demo_contact`

### Relationships

* Belongs to **DemoClient** via `demoCtcCliId` (required) — on parent delete: cascade
* Belongs to **DemoOrder** via `demoCtcOrdId` (optional) — on parent delete: cascade
* Has many **DemoContactHistoric** via `row_ref_id` [on delete: cascade, visible]

### Fields

| Name                                                         | Type                                     | Column                         | Required | Updatable | Personal | Description                                                                      |
|--------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|--------------------------------|----------|-----------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **`demoCtcCliId`** link to **`DemoClient`**                  | id                                       | ctc_cli_id                     | yes*     | yes       |          | Contact customer                                                                 |
| **`demoCtcOrdId`** link to **`DemoOrder`**                   | id                                       | ctc_ord_id                     |          | yes       |          | Contact order                                                                    |
| _`demoCliCode`_                                              | _regexp(10)_                             | _cli_code_                     |          |           |          | _Customer code_                                                                  |
| _`demoCliFirstname`_                                         | _char(100)_                              | _cli_firstname_                |          |           | yes      | _Customer first name_                                                            |
| _`demoCliLastname`_                                          | _char(100)_                              | _cli_lastname_                 |          |           | yes      | _Customer last name_                                                             |
| _`demoCliEmail`_                                             | _email(50)_                              | _cli_email_                    |          |           | yes      | _Customer email address_                                                         |
| _`demoCliHomePhone`_                                         | _phone(20)_                              | _cli_homephone_                |          |           | yes      | _Customer home phone number_                                                     |
| _`demoCliWorkPhone`_                                         | _phone(20)_                              | _cli_workphone_                |          |           | yes      | _Customer work phone number_                                                     |
| _`demoCliMobilePhone`_                                       | _phone(20)_                              | _cli_mobilephone_              |          |           | yes      | _Customer mobile phone number_                                                   |
| _`demoCliFax`_                                               | _phone(20)_                              | _cli_fax_                      |          |           | yes      | _Customer fax number_                                                            |
| _`demoOrdNumber`_                                            | _int(11)_                                | _ord_number_                   |          |           |          | _Order number (automatically calculated at creation)_                            |
| _`demoOrdDate`_                                              | _date_                                   | _ord_date_                     |          |           |          | _Order date_                                                                     |
| _`demoOrdStatus`_                                            | _enum(30) using DEMO_ORD_STATUS list_    | _ord_status_                   |          |           |          | _Order status_                                                                   |
| _`demoOrdCliId`_                                             | _id_                                     | _ord_cli_id_                   |          |           |          | _Order customer_                                                                 |
| _`demoOrdPrdId`_                                             | _id_                                     | _ord_prd_id_                   |          |           |          | _Order product_                                                                  |
| _`demoPrdSupId`_                                             | _id_                                     | _prd_sup_id_                   |          |           |          | _Product supplier_                                                               |
| _`demoSupUsrId`_                                             | _id_                                     | _sup_usr_id_                   |          |           |          | _User responsible of supplier_                                                   |
| _`demoPrdReference`_                                         | _regexp(10)_                             | _prd_code_                     |          |           |          | _Product reference_                                                              |
| _`demoPrdName`_                                              | _char(100)_                              | _prd_name_                     |          |           |          | _Product name_                                                                   |
| _`demoOrdQuantity`_                                          | _int(11)_                                | _ord_quantity_                 |          |           |          | _Product quantity ordered_                                                       |
| `demoCtcDatetime`                                            | datetime                                 | ctc_datetime                   | yes*     |           |          | Contcat date and time                                                            |
| `demoCtcType`                                                | enum(10) using DEMO_CTC_TYPE list        | ctc_type                       | yes      | yes       |          | Contact type                                                                     |
| `demoCtcSubType`                                             | enum(10) using DEMO_CTC_SUBTYPE list     | ctc_subtype                    |          | yes       |          | Contact sub type                                                                 |
| `demoCtcCanal`                                               | enum(10) using DEMO_CTC_CANAL list       | ctc_canal                      | yes      | yes       |          | Canal used for contact                                                           |
| `demoCtcPriority`                                            | boolean                                  | ctc_priority                   | yes      | yes       |          | Contact priority                                                                 |
| `demoCtcStatus`                                              | enum(1) using DEMO_CTC_STATUS list       | ctc_status                     | yes      | yes       |          | Contact status                                                                   |
| `demoCtcComments`                                            | notepad(2147483647)                      | ctc_comments                   |          | yes       |          | Comments on contact                                                              |
| `demoCtcFile`                                                | document                                 | ctc_file                       |          | yes       |          | Contact attached file                                                            |
| `demoCtcPicture`                                             | image                                    | ctc_picture                    |          | yes       |          | -                                                                                |
| `demoCtcMessages`                                            | notepad(2147483647)                      | ctc_messages                   | yes      | yes       |          | Messages                                                                         |

### Enumerations

* `DEMO_CTC_TYPE`
    - `INF` Information → `demoCtcSubType` uses `DEMO_CTC_SUBTYPE_INF`
        * `ORDSTATUS` Order status
        * `PRDINFO` Product information
    - `REQ` Request → `demoCtcSubType` uses `DEMO_CTC_SUBTYPE_REQ`
        * `ORDCANCEL` Order cancelation
        * `ORDCHANGE` Order change
    - `CMP` Complaint → `demoCtcSubType` uses `DEMO_CTC_SUBTYPE_CMP`
        * `ORDISSUE` Order issue
        * `BILLISSUE` Billing issue
    - `OTH` Other
* `DEMO_CTC_SUBTYPE`
    - `EMPTY` 
* `DEMO_CTC_CANAL`
    - `PHONE` Code PHONE
    - `EMAIL` Code EMAIL
    - `CHAT` Code CHAT
    - `WEB` Code WEB
* `DEMO_CTC_STATUS`
    - `O` Open
    - `P` Processing
    - `C` Closed

### State transitions (`demoCtcStatus`)

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    state "Open" as O
    state "Processing" as P
    state "Closed" as C
    O --> P
    O --> C
    P --> O
    P --> C
    C --> O
```

### Constraints

* **DemoContact-C1**: Fields not updatable by default
    - Condition: `true`
    - Effects: back
    - Impacts:
        - demoCtcStatus.updatable = `false`
        - demoCtcType.updatable = `false`
        - demoCtcSubType.updatable = `false`
        - demoCtcCanal.updatable = `false`
        - demoCtcCliId.updatable = `false`
        - demoCtcOrdId.updatable = `false`
* **DemoContact-C2**: Status field only updatable by the administrator
    - Condition: `![ISNEW]`
    - Effects: back
    - Impacts:
        - demoCtcStatus.updatable = `true`
* **DemoContact-C4**: Show/hide sub-type depending on type
    - Condition: `true`
    - Effects: back, front
    - Impacts:
        - demoCtcSubType.visible = `![FIELD:demoCtcType].isEmpty() && [VALUE:demoCtcType] != "OTH"`
        - demoCtcSubType.mandatory = `![FIELD:demoCtcType].isEmpty() && [VALUE:demoCtcType] != "OTH"`
* **DemoContact-C3**: Fields updatable at creation
    - Condition: `[ISNEW]`
    - Effects: back
    - Impacts:
        - demoCtcType.updatable = `true`
        - demoCtcSubType.updatable = `true`
        - demoCtcCanal.updatable = `true`
        - demoCtcCliId.updatable = `true`
        - demoCtcOrdId.updatable = `true`
* **DemoContact-C5**: Allow order selection **after** customer selection
    - Condition: `true`
    - Effects: front
    - Impacts:
        - demoCtcOrdId.updatable = `[ISNEW] && ![FIELD:demoCtcCliId].isEmpty()`

### Description (from code)

> Contact business object

### Implemented hooks

* `printMustache`: HTML publication (using Mustache(R) templating) method
* `printExcel`: Microsoft Excel(R) sheet publication method
* `postLoad`
* `canReference`
* `getUserKeyLabel`

`DemoOrder` (Order) business object definition
----------------------------------------------

The **order** business object corresponds to the
product orders placed by clients.

An order is for one single product.

**Physical table**: `demo_order`

### Relationships

* Belongs to **DemoClient** via `demoOrdCliId` (required) — on parent delete: cascade
* Belongs to **DemoProduct** via `demoOrdPrdId` (required) — on parent delete: cascade
* Has many **DemoContact** via `demoCtcOrdId` [on delete: cascade, visible]
* Has many **DemoOrderHistoric** via `row_ref_id` [on delete: cascade, visible]

### Fields

| Name                                                         | Type                                     | Column                         | Required | Updatable | Personal | Description                                                                      |
|--------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|--------------------------------|----------|-----------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **`demoOrdCliId`** link to **`DemoClient`**                  | id                                       | ord_cli_id                     | yes*     | yes       |          | Order customer                                                                   |
| **`demoOrdPrdId`** link to **`DemoProduct`**                 | id                                       | ord_prd_id                     | yes*     | yes       |          | Order product                                                                    |
| _`demoCliCode`_                                              | _regexp(10)_                             | _cli_code_                     |          |           |          | _Customer code_                                                                  |
| _`demoCliFirstname`_                                         | _char(100)_                              | _cli_firstname_                |          |           | yes      | _Customer first name_                                                            |
| _`demoCliLastname`_                                          | _char(100)_                              | _cli_lastname_                 |          |           | yes      | _Customer last name_                                                             |
| _`demoCliEmail`_                                             | _email(50)_                              | _cli_email_                    |          |           | yes      | _Customer email address_                                                         |
| _`demoCliAddress1`_                                          | _char(100)_                              | _cli_address1_                 |          |           | yes      | _Customer address (line 1)_                                                      |
| _`demoCliAddress2`_                                          | _char(100)_                              | _cli_address2_                 |          |           | yes      | _Customer address (line 2)_                                                      |
| _`demoCliZipCode`_                                           | _char(10)_                               | _cli_zipcode_                  |          |           | yes      | _Customer postal code_                                                           |
| _`demoCliCity`_                                              | _char(50)_                               | _cli_city_                     |          |           | yes      | _Customer city_                                                                  |
| _`demoCliCountry`_                                           | _enum(30) using DEMO_COUNTRY list_       | _cli_country_                  |          |           | yes      | _Customer country_                                                               |
| _`demoPrdReference`_                                         | _regexp(10)_                             | _prd_code_                     |          |           |          | _Product reference_                                                              |
| _`demoPrdName`_                                              | _char(100)_                              | _prd_name_                     |          |           |          | _Product name_                                                                   |
| _`demoPrdType`_                                              | _enum(50) using DEMO_PRD_TYPE list_      | _prd_type_                     |          |           |          | _Product type_                                                                   |
| _`demoPrdEan13`_                                             | _char(13)_                               | _prd_ean13_                    |          |           |          | _EAN13 code_                                                                     |
| _`demoPrdSupId`_                                             | _id_                                     | _prd_sup_id_                   |          |           |          | _Product supplier_                                                               |
| _`demoSupCode`_                                              | _regexp(50)_                             | _sup_code_                     |          |           |          | _Supplier unique code (e.g. `MYSUP`)_                                            |
| _`demoSupName`_                                              | _char(100)_                              | _sup_name_                     |          |           |          | _Supplier name_                                                                  |
| _`demoSupUsrId`_                                             | _id_                                     | _sup_usr_id_                   |          |           |          | _User responsible of supplier_                                                   |
| _`demoPrdStock`_                                             | _int(11)_                                | _prd_stock_                    |          |           |          | _Current stock for product_                                                      |
| _`demoPrdUnitPrice`_                                         | _float(11, 0)_                           | _prd_unitprice_                |          |           |          | _Unit price of product_                                                          |
| `demoOrdNumber`                                              | int(11)                                  | ord_number                     | yes*     |           |          | Order number (automatically calculated at creation)                              |
| `demoOrdDate`                                                | date                                     | ord_date                       |          |           |          | Order date                                                                       |
| `demoOrdStatus`                                              | enum(30) using DEMO_ORD_STATUS list      | ord_status                     | yes      | yes       |          | Order status                                                                     |
| `demoOrdDeliveryDate`                                        | datetime                                 | ord_deliverydate               |          | yes       |          | Order delivery date                                                              |
| `demoOrdUnitPrice`                                           | float(11, 2)                             | ord_unitprice                  |          |           |          | Product unit price for order                                                     |
| `demoOrdQuantity`                                            | int(11)                                  | ord_quantity                   | yes      | yes       |          | Product quantity ordered                                                         |
| `demoOrdTotal`                                               | float(11, 0)                             | ord_total                      |          |           |          | Total order amount                                                               |
| `demoOrdVAT`                                                 | float(11, 2)                             |                                |          |           |          | VAT for order                                                                    |
| `demoOrdComments`                                            | notepad(2147483647)                      | ord_comments                   |          | yes       |          | Comments on order                                                                |

### Enumerations

* `DEMO_ORD_STATUS`
    - `P` Pending status
    - `H` On hold
    - `V` Validated status
    - `D` Shipped status
    - `C` Canceled status

### State transitions (`demoOrdStatus`)

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    state "Pending status" as P
    state "Validated status" as V
    state "On hold" as H
    state "Canceled status" as C
    state "Shipped status" as D
    P --> V
    P --> H
    P --> C
    V --> P
    V --> H
    V --> D
    V --> C
    H --> P
    H --> V
    H --> C
    C --> P
    C --> V
    D --> [*]
```

### Constraints

* **DemoOrder-C1**: Fields not updatable by default
    - Condition: `true`
    - Effects: back
    - Impacts:
        - demoOrdStatus.updatable = `false`
        - demoOrdQuantity.updatable = `false`
        - demoOrdCliId.updatable = `false`
        - demoOrdPrdId.updatable = `false`
        - demoOrdDeliveryDate.visible = `ObjectField.VIS_NOT`
        - demoOrdDeliveryDate.updatable = `false`
        - demoOrdDeliveryDate.mandatory = `false`
* **DemoOrder-C2**: Status field only updatable by the administrator
    - Condition: `true`
    - Effects: back
    - Impacts:
        - demoOrdStatus.updatable = `true`
* **DemoOrder-C3**: Customer, product and quantity fields updatable at creation or when the order  is still in pending state
    - Condition: `[ISNEW] || [STATUS] == "P"`
    - Effects: back
    - Impacts:
        - demoOrdQuantity.updatable = `true`
        - demoOrdCliId.updatable = `true`
        - demoOrdPrdId.updatable = `true`
* **DemoOrder-C4**: Delivery date field only updatable when the order is not delivered nor cancelled
    - Condition: `![ISNEW] && [STATUS] != "C"`
    - Effects: back
    - Impacts:
        - demoOrdDeliveryDate.visible = `ObjectField.VIS_FORM`
        - demoOrdDeliveryDate.updatable = `[STATUS] != "D" && [STATUS] != "C"`
* **DemoOrder-C5**: Delivery order field mandatory at validation
    - Condition: `[STATUS] == "V"`
    - Effects: back
    - Impacts:
        - demoOrdDeliveryDate.mandatory = `true`
* **DemoOrder-C6**: Allow order deleteion only in pending state
    - Condition: `true`
    - Effects: back
    - Impacts:
        - object.delete = `[STATUS] == "P"`
* **DemoOrder-C7**: Update order only if administrator or if responsible of the product's supplier
    - Condition: `true`
    - Effects: back
    - Impacts:
        - object.update = `[VALUE:demoOrdPrdId.demoPrdSupId.demoSupUsrId] == [USERID]+""`
        - object.delete = `[VALUE:demoOrdPrdId.demoPrdSupId.demoSupUsrId] == [USERID]+""`

### Description (from code)

> Order business object

### Implemented hooks

* `postValidate`
* `postUpdate`
* `postSave`
* `canReference`
* `isPrintTemplateEnable`
* `getUserKeyLabel`

* Has many **DemoProduct** via `demoPrdSupId` [on delete: cascade, visible]

`DemoProduct` (Product) business object definition
--------------------------------------------------

The **product** business object corresponds to the
products that can be ordered.

Its reference is unique per supplier.

**Physical table**: `demo_product`

### Relationships

* Belongs to **DemoSupplier** via `demoPrdSupId` (required) — on parent delete: cascade
* Has many **DemoOrder** via `demoOrdPrdId` [on delete: cascade, hidden]
* Has many **DemoProductHistoric** via `row_ref_id` [on delete: cascade, visible]

### Fields

| Name                                                         | Type                                     | Column                         | Required | Updatable | Personal | Description                                                                      |
|--------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|--------------------------------|----------|-----------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **`demoPrdSupId`** link to **`DemoSupplier`**                | id                                       | prd_sup_id                     | yes      | yes       |          | Product supplier                                                                 |
| _`demoSupCode`_                                              | _regexp(50)_                             | _sup_code_                     |          |           |          | _Supplier unique code (e.g. `MYSUP`)_                                            |
| _`demoSupName`_                                              | _char(100)_                              | _sup_name_                     |          |           |          | _Supplier name_                                                                  |
| _`demoSupUsrId`_                                             | _id_                                     | _sup_usr_id_                   |          |           |          | _User responsible of supplier_                                                   |
| `demoPrdReference`                                           | regexp(10)                               | prd_code                       | yes*     |           |          | Product reference                                                                |
| `demoPrdName`                                                | char(100)                                | prd_name                       | yes      | yes       |          | Product name                                                                     |
| `demoPrdType`                                                | enum(50) using DEMO_PRD_TYPE list        | prd_type                       | yes      | yes       |          | Product type                                                                     |
| `demoPrdDescription`                                         | text(1000000)                            | prd_description                |          | yes       |          | Product description                                                              |
| `demoPrdPicture`                                             | image                                    | prd_picture                    |          | yes       |          | Product picture                                                                  |
| `demoPrdEan13`                                               | char(13)                                 | prd_ean13                      |          | yes       |          | EAN13 code                                                                       |
| `demoPrdEan13Image`                                          | image                                    | prd_ean13_image                |          | yes       |          | EAN13 code image                                                                 |
| `demoPrdStock`                                               | int(11)                                  | prd_stock                      | yes      | yes       |          | Current stock for product                                                        |
| `demoPrdUnitPrice`                                           | float(11, 0)                             | prd_unitprice                  | yes      | yes       |          | Unit price of product                                                            |
| `demoPrdAvailable`                                           | boolean                                  | prd_available                  | yes      | yes       |          | Available product?                                                               |
| `demoPrdFeatured`                                            | boolean                                  | prd_featured                   | yes      | yes       |          | Featured product?                                                                |
| `demoPrdDocumentation`                                       | html(1000000)                            | prd_documentation              |          | yes       |          | Product documentation                                                            |
| `demoPrdBrochure`                                            | document                                 | prd_brochure                   |          | yes       |          | Product brochure                                                                 |
| `demoPrdOnlineDoc`                                           | url(255)                                 | prd_onlinedoc                  |          | yes       |          | Online product documentation URL                                                 |
| `demoPrdComments`                                            | notepad(2147483647)                      | prd_comments                   |          | yes       |          | Comments on product                                                              |

### Enumerations

* `DEMO_PRD_TYPE`
    - `LAPTOP` Laptop
    - `DESKTOP` Desktop
    - `TABLET` Tablet
    - `SMARTPHONE` Smartphone
    - `OTHER` Other

### Custom actions

* `DEMO_INCSTOCK`: Sample action for product stock **increment**
(by `N` specified in the product business object code).
* `DEMO_DECSTOCK`: Product stock **decrement** triggered by the order
state transition to _shipped_ status.
* `DEMO_PRD_EMAIL`: Send product information by email

### Description (from code)

> Product business object

* `initAction`
* `preSave`
* `canReference`
* `getUserKeyLabel`
* `sendEmail`: Send product data in an email action method

`DemoClient` (Customer) business object definition
--------------------------------------------------

The **customer** business object corresponds
to the customer who places order.

His address is geolocalized using GoogleMaps&reg; API.

**Physical table**: `demo_client`

### Relationships

* Has many **DemoContact** via `demoCtcCliId` [on delete: cascade, visible]
* Has many **DemoOrder** via `demoOrdCliId` [on delete: cascade, visible]

## Process: DemoOrderCreate

**Order entry** activity workflow

### Activities

* `Begin`: Begin activity -> `ClientSelect`
* `ClientSelect`: Customer selection activity -> `SupplierSelect`
* `SupplierSelect`: Supplier selection activity -> `ProductSelect`
* `ProductSelect`: Selected supplier's product selection activity -> `OrderCreate`
* `OrderCreate`: Order creation form activity -> `End`
* `End`: End activity _(terminal)_

External objects
----------------

* `DemoCarousel`: Products carousel ----------------- This UI widget is only displaying **featured** products.
* `DemoCatalog`: Products catalog page --------------------- This UI widget/page is only displaying **available** products.
* `DemoCatalogAPI`: Custom catalog REST web service ------------------------------- This custom API returns the available products only.
* `DemoContacts`: Contacts widget --------------- This UI widget is diplaying the list of contacts.
* `DemoCounters`: Counters -------- This UI widget is displaying various counters.
* `DemoNews`: News widget ----------- This UI widget is diplaying the standard platform news data. Note that the instance name `web_WebNews` is on purpose. Using this instance name applies the date-based, language-based and rights filterings.
* `DemoOrderAgenda`: Delivery agenda --------------- This redirects to the standard orders' agenda
* `DemoPlaceNewOrder`: Custom place new order page --------------------------- This custom Ui page is dedicated to place orders using simplified UX.
* `DemoSupplierStats`: _No description._

Shared code
-----------

* `DemoCommon` _(Server script)_
* `DemoRandomDataGeneration` _(Test script)_
* `DemoTests` _(Test script)_
